I am an old woman, 82 years, and I farm this small piece of land alone with what little strength I have. On this bean plot I do not buy fertilizer — beans do not need it like maize does, and the FISP coupons, when they come, I save for the maize plot. I will plant the seeds I kept from last harvest, and I intercrop as I always have. My grandchildren help me weed when they can.
